title: Turning Toward
logline: At a town three-wheeler stand, a driver's eyes move to every passer-by, and in a fraction of a second, before anyone speaks, he has already decided: customer, or not.

object.note: Object 5 (identity not chosen) may appear subtly, for example among Chathura's things while he travels, waits or watches, only where it sits naturally in a real moment. Never staged, never the subject.

thread_in.thread: The instant before naming carries into a town's three-wheeler stand, where a driver's eyes turn to each passer-by and a judgement forms before anyone speaks.

thread_out.thread: From faces glimpsed and let go to a place long remembered: a woman returning after years of work abroad, the other side of the choice left open in 'Not Yet Decided'.

requirements: A busy three-wheeler stand with drivers willing to be filmed over a working day
A vantage point that can follow both the driver and the passing street
Consent that respects the driver's livelihood and does not slow his actual work

suggestions.name: A busy stand in a market town
suggestions.region: Any market town, to be selected
suggestions.why: Three-wheeler stands are a near-universal feature of Sri Lankan town life; a specific town is left open.
suggestions.verify: A specific stand and a willing driver are unconfirmed.
